title: Question 24
passage:
With the station elevator out, I don't see how we'll get the stroller across.
A. The elevator on this side broke down yesterday. B. The stairs go straight to the other side. C. There's a ramp to the other side by the bike racks.
passageZh:
車站的電梯壞了，我不知道要怎麼推嬰兒車過去。
A. 這一側的電梯昨天就壞了。
B. 樓梯可以直接走到另一側。
C. 自行車架旁邊有一條通到對面的坡道。
